desc: Prove the exact reduction from pairing to selecting 2K cakes assigned to three coordinate buckets of even sizes.
Derive and prove the constant-exception algorithm with at most two non-canonical assignments.
Produce the Python implementation using canonical groups, prefix sums, local count-triple enumeration, and exceptional candidate enumeration.
Validate the implementation against exhaustive/random small-instance oracles, including ties, duplicates, and K=floor(N/2).
